يستقذروا (form X)
# يَسْتَقْذِرُوا (yastaqḏirū) /jas.taq.ði.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
# يُسْتَقْذَرُوا (yustaqḏarū) /jus.taq.ða.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
